Intro, relating back to previous section and giving an overview of what’s in store

We have normative, cortex-scale loss functions, now onto the actual hardware that computes and routes error signals

The preceding section established the form and structure of the cortical loss; we now turn to the neural machinery that computes, weights, and routes the error signals that this loss implies.
